# Kyrosh — Digital Growth Agency

> Kyrosh is a global premier full-stack digital growth agency engineering bespoke websites, custom software/AI ERP platforms, 10x ROAS performance marketing funnels, 3D cinematic video production, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

## Agency Facts & Overview
- **Agency Name**: Kyrosh
- **Website**: https://kyrosh.in
- **Core Specializations**: Web Development, Custom Software Development, Meta & Google Performance Ads, 3D Product Animations & UGC Video Production, SEO & GEO AI Optimization, Brand Identity & Packaging.
- **Founding Leadership**:

- **Key Metrics & Track Record**:

  - Sub-second TTFB latency & 99+ Google Lighthouse performance scores

## Service Offerings & Pricing Packages
1. **Starter Growth Package**: ₹9,000 / project (50% Welcome Discount applied from standard ₹18,000). High-converting business website, complete logo & branding kit, Google Business & local SEO, and 5 high-impact social creatives.
2. **Scale & Dominance Package**: ₹29,000 / month (50% VIP Rate applied from standard ₹58,000). Flagship enterprise growth package including Next.js/React web applications, multi-tier Meta/Google Ads management, 8 high-converting UGC/3D video creatives monthly, full GEO/SEO dominance, and dedicated account strategist.
3. **Enterprise Custom Scope**: ₹49,000 / month (Bespoke architecture, custom AI ERP workflows, unlimited creative production, and guaranteed ROI SLA).
